examples.arabic: دخلت بسرعة قبل ما الراجل يقفل بابه، وقالت بلهفة: "مساء الخير يا حاج، ممكن لحظة من فضلك؟"
examples.english: She quickly entered before the man closed his door, and said eagerly: "Good evening, Hajj, a moment please?"
examples.transliteration: Dakhalet be-sor3a abl ma el-ragel ye2fel babo, we 2alet be-lahfa: "Masa' el-kheir ya ḥagg, momken laḥza men faḍlak?"
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.english: This is a warm and beautiful family moment.
